persons.name: Kalahābhimānin
persons.evidence: sa śrīmān-kalahābhimāni-nṛpatiḥ ... teneyaṃ ... rājñā śrī-kalahābhimāni ... pātayitvā praṇālīm

purpose: construction of a water conduit (praṇālī) at an abode of ascetics (yativaravāsa)
notes: The inscription is fragmentary and lacks a date. Kalahābhimānin is a known biruda/epithet of Mahāsāmanta Aṃśuvarman.
